name: Darryl Yeo
description:
Darryl Yeo is a self-taught software engineer with over a decade of experience building delightful data-driven experiences for the decentralized web. He previously built websites and user interfaces at dYdX, Ritual, ETHGlobal, Spindl and Coinbase.

Today, Darryl focuses on building open-source tools that promote transparency and self-sovereignty in crypto ecosystems, including Walletbeat, a community standard for Ethereum wallets, and Blockhead, a local-first client for decentralized protocols.
